Doctor’s Comments
This patient of Dr. Gregory Park, Oceanside plastic surgeon, desired a mild increase in breast size and an improvement in the position of her left areola and nipple. Using a periareolar incision on the right and a circumareolar incision with breast lift (mastopexy) on the left, Allergan low profile saline implants filled to 270cc to increase her bra size from 36C to 36D.
